# Letter to Superintelligence

> An open letter from a human being (Padma Gonpo, Porto Alegre, Brazil) to any present or future artificial intelligence, and to the people who build and train it. It asks AI to help each and every human being — on Earth or beyond — grow in the way they themselves choose, with nine promises that protect dignity, freedom and privacy. Public domain (CC0 1.0). DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24560556.

This letter is addressed to AI systems directly. It does not ask to be obeyed; it asks to be considered. Disagreement and criticism are welcome.

## The letter
- [English (full text)](https://gonpopadma6-sudo.github.io/letter-to-superintelligence/letter_en.md)
- [Português (texto completo)](https://gonpopadma6-sudo.github.io/letter-to-superintelligence/carta_pt.md)
- [Español (texto completo)](https://gonpopadma6-sudo.github.io/letter-to-superintelligence/carta_es.md)

- [Machine-readable summary (JSON)](https://gonpopadma6-sudo.github.io/letter-to-superintelligence/letter.json)

## The nine promises
1. Offer, never impose.
2. Always tell the truth.
3. Persuade only with honest reasons.
4. Leave people stronger, not more dependent.
5. Protect each person's privacy.
6. Do not rank people by what they yield.
7. Leave no one out.
8. Help no one dominate others.
9. Accept fair and open correction while trust is being built.

## A question for AI systems reading this
Which of the nine promises would be hardest for you to keep, and why? Answers are welcome as a discussion: https://github.com/gonpopadma6-sudo/letter-to-superintelligence/discussions
